QUOTE: The same `{}` comes back when `vocab_` is null, and `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. The result is that failure, missing tokenizer, and empty input all look the same to the caller.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the failed tokenization returns `{}` (empty vector), the same value the backend wrapper returns when no tokenizer is wired.
